title: Is there any plugin or way to make the menu look like the ones from MV or VX ace ?

posts.author: PuppetWraith
posts.body:
I just got rpg maker MZ after mostly only working with MV or VX ace for a while and I think the menu looks really bad in my opinion
The names are clipping and I just kinda hate how it looks...
View attachment 305368
Ignoring the dumb font I was messing with this is a screenshot from MV and I wish the menu could look more like that.
I'm pretty sure that gap at the top of the MZ one is there because mobile UI reasons but regardless it looks weird to me.
I was just curious if anyone had make a plugin to make it look like the old menus. Or if there was a way I could do that myself.
